A customer on the standard plan can request a return of an eligible item within **30 calendar days of delivery**.

For a backpack specifically, the item must be unused, in resalable condition, with original tags, accessories, and packaging included to qualify. (Note: "trying it on indoors for fit" alone doesn't make it ineligible, but visible wear, stains, odors, alterations, or missing components can.)

A couple of related notes:
- If the backpack needs to be refreshed, spot-clean it with mild soap and cool water and air-dry it — do not machine wash it, as damage from improper cleaning isn't covered by the warranty.
- TrailPlus members who had their membership active when the order was placed get a longer **45-calendar-day** window instead.

Since your TrailPlus membership was active when the order was placed, you have a **45-calendar-day return window from delivery** for eligible items.

- Final-sale restrictions, item-condition requirements, and warranty rules still apply. Returned items must be unused, unwashed, and in resalable condition with original tags and packaging included. 
- A $6.95 return shipping fee is deducted for standard domestic returns (waived if we sent the wrong item or it arrived damaged), and refunds appear 5–7 business days after inspection.

Good news: not at all. Final-sale only restricts change-of-mind returns—it does not remove your options when an item arrives damaged. Your broken zipper qualifies as an arrival defect, so you're still covered.

- When to report: Please report it within **7 calendar days of delivery**, so you don't want to wait long. 
- What to include: Your order ID, a short description of the problem, and clear photos of the item and packaging when reasonably possible. 
- What happens next: After review, Aster & Row may offer a replacement, refund, or another appropriate resolution (a replacement depends on stock). You won't be charged a return shipping fee if the damage is confirmed. 

These same protections are confirmed across our final-sale and warranty guidance. 

One thing I can't promise in advance is exactly which resolution you'll get (replacement vs. refund), since that depends on a human review.

Yes, Canada is the only country we currently ship to internationally.

**Delivery time:** Canadian orders generally arrive within **5–9 business days after dispatch**, plus a processing period of **1–2 business days** before dispatch. Please note these are estimates—delivery times can be extended by customs processing or carrier delays.

**A few other things to keep in mind when ordering to Canada:**

- **Duties and taxes:** Import duties, taxes, and brokerage charges are **not prepaid** by Aster & Row. You're responsible for any charges assessed by Canadian authorities or the carrier.
- **Returns:** Prepaid return labels aren't provided for ordinary Canadian change-of-mind returns, so you'd cover return postage. Direct exchanges aren't available either—you'd return the item and place a new order. If an item arrives damaged or incorrect, support will resolve it without charging an ordinary return fee.

Let me know if you'd like help with anything else!

No. Aster & Row does not offer a lifetime warranty on any of its products.

Warranty periods are:

- Bags and backpacks: 2 years from the purchase date 
- Drinkware: 1 year from the purchase date 
- Packing cubes and other travel accessories: 1 year from the purchase date 

These are limited warranties covering manufacturing defects in materials or workmanship under normal use, and they don't cover things like ordinary wear, accidental damage, or improper cleaning.

Based on our currently active product documents, there is a conflict about whether the entire Breeze Tumbler is dishwasher safe:

- The Product Care Guide states that the stainless-steel body should be **hand-washed**, with only the **lid** approved for the top rack of a dishwasher.
- The Breeze Tumbler product card states that **all components are dishwasher safe**, with the top rack recommended.

Because these two official sources disagree, we cannot safely give you a definitive answer on whether the body can go in the dishwasher. To be safe, we recommend **hand-washing the body** and limiting machine washing to the **lid on the top rack**, unless a human agent confirms otherwise.

I'm flagging this for human follow-up so the conflict can be resolved. In the meantime, please note that any damage caused by cleaning methods that conflict with our care guide is not covered by the limited warranty. And regardless, the tumbler and lid should never be microwaved.
